page.adminDesc: Protected operational data, user-role controls, source freshness and audit review. Server-side role checks remain authoritative.
page.calendarDesc: Review due dates and persist task state changes through the backend. Dates do not imply that a task was completed in the field.
page.cropHealthDesc: Upload a clear plant photo for a preliminary model response. The result is not a confirmed diagnosis.
page.cropPlanningDesc: Compare a model-backed crop suggestion when its model is available, and keep crop calendars and task records in one place.
page.damageDesc: Create an in-app evidence record with location and date. It is not submitted to an insurer or government authority by this app.
page.diaryDesc: Record field activities, observations, labour, purchases and photos with a clear date and selected farm.
page.equipmentDesc: Review available listings where published, submit a booking request where supported and verify availability with the provider.
page.evidenceDesc: Upload and privately store image evidence. This endpoint does not provide an account-wide upload listing; keep returned IDs with the related record.
page.expertDesc: Ask crop-related questions, read returned answers and separate expert responses from model output and farmer reports.
page.familyDesc: Use limited, explicit permissions with a registered farmer account. Never share passwords or unrestricted account access.
page.farmsDesc: Keep each farm and plot separate so crop notes, irrigation, expenses and harvest records can be attached to the correct land.
page.financeDesc: Track recorded expenses and income, plus user-entered break-even and storage scenarios. Unrecorded costs are not included.
page.harvestDesc: Record harvest quantity, quality, drying and storage requests. Provider availability must be confirmed directly.
page.helpDesc: Find official links returned by the backend and understand which services need local verification.
page.livestockDesc: Keep animal, vaccination, dairy and fish-pond records. This is record-keeping, not veterinary diagnosis.
page.marketplaceDesc: Manage buyer requests, farmer produce listings, FPO and community information with privacy-aware public fields.
page.marketsDesc: Compare dated price records and calculate scenarios from values you enter. No future-price or profit guarantees are made.
page.moreDesc: The platform is organized into focused workspaces, not one oversized dashboard. Choose a tool to open its own screen.
page.notificationsDesc: Review in-app notifications and published notices. No SMS or push delivery is claimed.
page.offlineDesc: Drafts shown here are stored on this device. They remain local until the backend confirms each item as SYNCED.
page.schemesDesc: Browse published scheme records and record your own follow-up. A possible match is not an eligibility decision.
page.seedSafetyDesc: Capture packet evidence, review extracted text, compare QR contents, keep a home germination record and prepare a documented complaint.
page.settingsDesc: Manage profile and language, inspect privacy limits and clear locally stored offline drafts from this device.
page.soilInputsDesc: Keep test values and input purchases traceable to the farm. Simple reference checks are not fertilizer prescriptions.
page.weatherDesc: Weather is shown only when the backend returns it. A cached observation is never presented as fresh current weather.
